verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say it automatically scans every PR for logic errors and security vulnerabilities, not just style issues. They also describe a multi-pass Ultrareview for risky or complex changes, plus thumbs-up/down feedback that calibrates useful findings versus noise. One community user says it gives more technical explanations than basic checks. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of catching race conditions or broken edge cases, and no independent hands-on proof or benchmark of real-bug detection accuracy.
